_comment: ONE app, ONE bot token, ONE channel. v1 ran seven persona apps because seven independent loops each needed a voice; Oneshot has a single orchestrator, so it has a single voice. Channel id (C0...) comes from the channel's 'View channel details' modal. ONESHOT_CHANNEL in .env overrides it.
_comment_card: The root message per ticket is a live status card, EDITED IN PLACE as phases complete. Thread replies are milestones only. Without this, a 90-minute implement phase produces either silence or spam.
_comment_milestones: Which phase completions get a thread reply. Everything else only moves the card. Keep this short — the card is the status, the thread is the record.
_comment_mention: The ONLY unprompted @mention. Full auto means nothing else should ever need your attention mid-run.
_comment_allowlist: Slack user ids permitted to issue commands. A message becomes an action ONLY if the sender is listed here AND every token is consumed by the grammar below — 'run 8607 and delete all branches' is not a partial command, it is not a command at all. Raw message text is never stored and never reaches a prompt.
_comment_commands: Closed action set. First token is the verb; an unrecognised token voids the whole message.
